# Narration script

Every narrated line, from `Tools/narration-registry.json` and the String Catalog. Change wording in `Localizable.xcstrings` (the key for the screen, `speak.<key>` for spoken wording that differs), then re-record the line with `--only` and refresh this sheet.

**Display:** *screen*: the text is shown while it is spoken. *partly*: shown in some screens only (see the note). *voice*: heard, never shown. **Clip:** ✓ when every recording of the key is bundled.
